title: Photo Album for Mum: Chapters, Voice Notes and a Link Gift | Albums.ink
desc: How to make a photo album for mum in Australia: chapters by year, voice notes from the kids and a private link she can open on any phone.
h1: Photo album for mum: a gift she can open on her phone
lead: A photo album for mum beats another candle — especially when the kids live in different cities and the best photos are stuck in separate camera rolls. In Australia, “mum” is the word on the gift tag. Here is a simple way to build a story album with chapters, short voice notes and a link she can keep.
body: ## What to put in a photo album for mum
- Childhood to now: scan a few old prints, then jump to recent holidays and Sunday lunches.
- One chapter per kid: each sibling adds photos and a 20-second voice note.
- Places she loves: the beach house, the garden, the café she always chooses.
- Everyday rituals: morning coffee, walking the dog — the small stuff she will replay.
## Build it as a free story album

On Albums you create a story album with chapters, photos, videos and voice notes. Add narration if you want a slideshow she can play through. For family sharing, add relatives as friends and choose Friends or Friends, except…. Only me does not grant access through a link. No ads. The album stays as long as you want it.
1. Create a free album and name it for her — e.g. “For Mum, 2026”.
2. Add chapters (Childhood, Our family, Holidays, This year).
3. Upload photos (up to 30 MB each) and short videos (up to 50 MB).
4. Record a voice note in the browser or upload audio (up to 20 MB).
5. Invite one co-author (a sibling who is already a friend on Albums) if you want help filling chapters.
6. Send her the link with cover preview — she opens it in the browser — nothing to install.
Related: photo album for grandma and add voice to photos.
## Why a link works better than a print-only gift
She can open it on the lounge TV or on her phone on the train. You can keep adding birthday and Christmas photos later. Download the whole album as one ZIP if you also want a backup.
